UsageNow

See what is left of every AI plan at a glance

UsageNow shows how much of each AI subscription you have used and exactly when it resets, in the app, on Home Screen widgets and on Apple Watch. It talks directly to each service from your device; there is no UsageNow server.

How UsageNow works

  • Direct from your device

    You add an account through that service's own sign-in page. When the app or its widget refreshes, your iPhone or iPad asks the service's API for your usage directly over HTTPS. Nothing passes through a UsageNow server, because there is none.

  • Sign-ins stay in the Keychain

    Sign-in tokens are stored only in this device's Keychain with AfterFirstUnlockThisDeviceOnly protection. They are shared only with the UsageNow Home Screen Widget so it can refresh by itself, and they are not synced to iCloud or sent to Apple Watch.

  • Widgets and Apple Watch

    The Widget and Apple Watch show the latest usage percentages and reset times. The paired Apple Watch receives only that snapshot, never a sign-in token.

  • 24-hour free trial, then one purchase

    Every feature is free for 24 hours after you tap Start 24-Hour Free Trial. UsageNow Pro is a one-time purchase through StoreKit with the price shown in your local currency. There is no subscription and no advertising.

Contact UsageNow support

Tell us your device model, iOS version, app version, which service the account belongs to, what you tapped, and roughly when it happened. Never send a password, sign-in code, access token, or screenshot that shows one.

hourstag.app@gmail.com
